release_policy: Three articles each weekday, one randomized minute in each requested window; owner-managed Prismic publication without editorial or specialist approval. Technical validation remains required.

articles.title: How to license business data for AI
articles.working_title: How to License Business Data for AI: A Practical Guide
articles.primary_query: license business data for AI
articles.brief: Explain licensing versus ownership; eligibility; scope; preparation; buyer review; payment contingencies. Start with a concise conditional answer, not a revenue promise.

articles.title: Can your company license its data?
articles.working_title: Can Your Company License Its Data? A Rights and Readiness Checklist
articles.primary_query: can I license my company data
articles.brief: Separate possession from authority; customer agreements, employee records, third-party IP, geography and exclusions. Include yes/no/escalate gates; a checklist is not legal clearance.

articles.title: What determines the value of business data?
articles.working_title: How Much Is Business Data Worth to AI Labs? What an Assessment Can—and Cannot—Tell You
articles.primary_query: business data valuation for AI
articles.brief: Discuss uniqueness, linked outcomes, usable history, rights, preparation costs, exclusivity and demand. Show qualitative scenarios, not unsupported dollar ranges. Distinguish gross licensing consideration from net proceeds.

articles.title: 12 terms to review in an AI data license
articles.working_title: AI Data Licensing Agreement: 12 Terms Business Owners Should Review
articles.primary_query: AI data licensing agreement
articles.brief: Cover parties, scope, rights, permitted purposes, exclusivity, onward sharing, security, retention, deletion, derived artifacts, fees and remedies. Explain which controls may not technically reverse model training. Not a legal template.

articles.title: Exclusive or non-exclusive data licensing?
articles.working_title: Exclusive vs. Non-Exclusive AI Data Licensing: A Decision Framework
articles.primary_query: exclusive vs non exclusive data license
articles.brief: Compare term, scope, permitted uses, minimum payment, opportunity cost and repeat licensing limits. Use labeled hypothetical scenarios and no guaranteed repeat revenue.

articles.title: What happens during a business-data assessment?
articles.working_title: What Happens During a Business-Data Assessment?
articles.primary_query: business data assessment
articles.brief: List systems, date ranges, record categories, approximate volumes and known restrictions. Begin with metadata only. Distinguish a proposed process from verified Rancher operations; describe sample-transfer gates conditionally.
articles.cta: Describe your systems; do not send data

articles.title: De-identification and anonymization are different
articles.working_title: De-Identification vs. Anonymization for AI Data Licensing
articles.primary_query: de identification vs anonymization AI data
articles.brief: Explain pseudonymization, direct and indirect identifiers, free text, linked-record re-identification and validation. Name replacement alone is not anonymization. Link current primary regulator guidance with jurisdiction-specific review.

articles.title: What to exclude from an AI training dataset
articles.working_title: What Data Should Never Be Included Without Further Review? An Exclusions Matrix
articles.primary_query: what data to exclude from AI training datasets
articles.brief: Cover credentials, privileged material, HR records, customer confidential content, regulated data, third-party code and contractual restrictions. State that even ordinary workflow records require review.

articles.title: Can support tickets be licensed for AI training?
articles.working_title: Can Support Tickets Be Licensed for AI Training?
articles.primary_query: license support tickets for AI training
articles.brief: Explain ticket, escalation, action and outcome fields; customer obligations; free-text review; exceptions and quality gates. Use invented records only; never claim Zendesk or Intercom integrations.

articles.title: What is a workflow trajectory?
articles.working_title: What Is a Workflow Trajectory? From Support Ticket to Verified Resolution
articles.primary_query: workflow trajectory AI training data
articles.brief: Define trajectory versus isolated record; show timestamps, actions, state changes and outcome with stable fictional IDs. Include missing-context and failure examples. Distinguish observed history from verified reasoning.

articles.title: Can Slack messages and email be licensed for AI?
articles.working_title: Can Slack Messages and Email Be Licensed for AI Training?
articles.primary_query: license Slack data for AI training
articles.brief: Discuss authority, employee notice/rights, customer contracts, attachments, sensitive channels, retention and platform terms. Do not suggest exporting everything or assume platform access creates licensing rights.
articles.cta: Discuss a narrowly scoped use case

articles.title: CRM histories need more than contact records
articles.working_title: CRM and Sales Histories for AI Training: Useful Context, Difficult Boundaries
articles.primary_query: CRM data for AI training licensing
articles.brief: Distinguish sales-process events from contact data; win/loss labels, incomplete stages, pricing confidentiality and customer restrictions. Show a fictional record chain; no assumed Salesforce/HubSpot connection.

articles.title: A rights checklist for licensing engineering data
articles.working_title: Licensing Source Code and Engineering History to AI Labs: A Rights Checklist
articles.primary_query: license source code to AI labs
articles.brief: Cover employee/contractor assignments, dependency licenses, secrets, proprietary customer code, PR reviews and issue histories. Separate operating-company licensing from asset sales. No valuation figures without primary evidence.

articles.title: Can you license the same dataset more than once?
articles.working_title: Can You License the Same Dataset More Than Once?
articles.primary_query: license same dataset multiple times
articles.brief: Answer conditionally; exclusivity, field-of-use, territory, time, buyer obligations, refresh rights and overlapping records can constrain reuse. Focus on implementation rather than repeat the exclusivity overview.

articles.title: Preserve workflow context while reducing privacy risk
articles.working_title: How to Preserve Workflow Context While Reducing Privacy Risk
articles.primary_query: preserve context de identified workflow data
articles.brief: Explain stable pseudonymous IDs, ordering, joins and attachment review; privacy-utility trade-offs and linkage risks. Demonstrate why replacing names is insufficient and how exclusions affect utility.

articles.title: How to review AI dataset quality
articles.working_title: AI Dataset Quality Checklist: Completeness, Outcomes, Provenance and Leakage
articles.primary_query: AI training dataset quality checklist
articles.brief: Define completeness, duplicates, label reliability, coverage, provenance and leakage checks. Publish illustrative acceptance tests; thresholds are buyer-specific, not verified Rancher standards.

articles.title: Training and evaluation data need different rules
articles.working_title: Training Data vs. Evaluation Data: Why the Intended Use Changes the License
articles.primary_query: training data vs evaluation data licensing
articles.brief: Define fine-tuning versus held-out evaluation and permitted-use boundaries; separate datasets to avoid contamination. Explain how use affects documentation, controls and commercial discussions.

articles.title: Direct licensing or a data partner?
articles.working_title: Direct Licensing vs. a Data Partner: How to Compare the Options
articles.primary_query: direct data licensing vs data marketplace
articles.brief: Compare buyer access, diligence, fees, preparation, security, exclusivity and reporting. Ask providers for proof; do not rank named competitors without fresh substantiation or claim Rancher capabilities.

articles.title: Business-data licensing questions answered
articles.working_title: AI Data Licensing FAQ: Ownership, Access, Confidentiality and Payment
articles.primary_query: AI data licensing FAQ
articles.brief: Answer the 8–10 final approval questions in 40–80 words each; link deep articles rather than duplicate them. Include no unrestricted access initially and no guaranteed qualification or earnings.
articles.cta: Explore a partnership with no data upload

articles.title: A practical data-card template for AI buyers
articles.working_title: Dataset Documentation for AI Buyers: A Practical Data-Card Template
articles.primary_query: AI dataset documentation template
articles.required_asset: Blank data card plus fictional filled example
articles.brief: Include origin, authority, scope, collection history, transformations, exclusions, limitations, split policy, allowed uses and contact. Clearly label all examples; no sample presented as Rancher inventory.

articles.title: A fictional workflow-data assessment
articles.working_title: What a Responsible Workflow-Data Assessment Looks Like: An Illustrated Walkthrough
articles.primary_query: workflow data assessment example
articles.brief: Follow a fictional support workflow from metadata inventory through rights gates, exclusions, privacy review, quality checks and proposed terms. Clearly label synthetic throughout; no invented customer or improvement metrics.

articles.title: Security questions before any data transfer
articles.working_title: AI Data Licensing Security Review: Questions to Ask Before Any Transfer
articles.primary_query: AI data licensing security checklist
articles.brief: Ask about access controls, approved transfer, encryption, subprocessors, logging, retention, incidents, deletion limits and evidence. Do not claim certifications or approved transfer methods Rancher cannot prove.

articles.title: Why a dataset might not qualify for licensing
articles.working_title: Why a Business Dataset May Not Qualify for AI Licensing
articles.primary_query: why data is not eligible for AI licensing
articles.brief: Explain rights gaps, sensitive content, missing outcomes, poor joins, preparation economics and absent demand. Offer safe next actions or a clear stop; no implication that remediation guarantees a buyer.
articles.cta: Discuss fit—or decide not to proceed

articles.title: Build a business-data licensing readiness plan
articles.working_title: Your Business-Data Licensing Readiness Plan: From Inventory to Go/No-Go
articles.primary_query: business data licensing readiness plan
articles.brief: Assign business, IT, legal and security owners; establish gates and unanswered questions before transfer. Recap the 12-week library as a decision path, not another broad introductory guide.
